segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Thank you very much and good afternoon, Madam Chair, Honorable Members of the House Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: On behalf of the Presidential Communications Office, let me express our gratitude for the gracious invitation today

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: and for the very warm welcome to the August halls of the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It will be my honor, together with the heads and officials of the PCO and our attached agencies,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: to present and explain the rationale behind our proposed budget for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: But before I proceed, Madam Chair, allow me to simply frame the context of our proposed 2027 appropriations.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: The PCO is proposing a budget of 2.62 billion pesos, which is 6.6% lower than our current 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: This represents a measly 0.03% of the total 7.2 trillion proposed national budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We have the lowest budget and the last department-level agency of the Executive Department in terms of budgetary allocation.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We may have the least in the budget priority, but we assure your honors that the PCO and our attached agencies are up to the Herculean task of engaging and involving the citizenry,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: and the mass media in enriching the quality of public discourse on all matters of governance.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: As I have just mentioned, the PCO family's budget proposal is 2.62 billion pesos, or around 0.03% of the 7.2 trillion national expenditure program for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Just very quickly, as per Executive Order No. 16, you will see that the PCO has six attached agencies and three GOCCs that are also attached to the PCO.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: They are the Bureau of Broadcast Services, the Bureau of Communication Services, the News and Information Bureau, the Philippine Information Agency, Radio TV Malacanang or RTVM,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: IBC 13, PTV 4, APO Press, and the Philippine Information Agency.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We have the EPO, the Program of Production, and the National Printing Office.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Here, the following are the major programs, activities, and projects to be funded by our proposed fiscal year 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: As Madam Chair pointed out, the highest in terms of our priorities, the Presidential Communications Program,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: is at the core of our mandate to serve as the primary communications arm of the Executive Department,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: ensuring that government messages are clear, consistent, and accessible to the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It focuses on the formulation, coordination, and implementation of integrated public information plans and programs that effectively communicate the priorities, policies, and achievements of the President and the Philippine Government.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It not only involves the crafting of messages, but also the careful alignment of communication strategies across all agencies to ensure coherence, clarity in how government policies and programs are conveyed to the public.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: In a time when information is fast-moving and often contested, the program ensures that our citizens receive timely, accurate, and relevant information straight from the government.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It is anchored on our sector outcome, which is people-centered, innovative, clean, efficient, effective, and inclusive delivery of public goods and services.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Strategic communications plays a vital role in realizing this outcome.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: reliable information, we strengthen transparency and accountability in governance, while ensuring that services and programs are better understood and appreciated by the people they are intended to serve.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Communication, therefore, becomes a tool not only for information sharing, but also for enabling citizens to fully benefit from government programs and participate in the democratic process.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: In line with this, the organizational outcome that we seek to achieve in public access,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: engagement, and participation in the democratic process,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: and understanding of presidential policies and government programs.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: This means that we are not only ensuring that information reaches the people, but also that it resonates with them and encourages meaningful dialogue.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Through accessible and inclusive communication, we empower citizens to engage in public discourse, to raise their concerns, and to take part in nation-building.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: In doing so, the program fosters a deeper appreciation of government initiatives and helps bridge the gap between policy formulation and citizen experience.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: To realize these outcomes, we are implementing several concrete activities.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Among this is the freedom of information program, which upholds transparency by granting citizens greater access to government data and information.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez

segments.text: Hindi naman po, Your Honor, hindi naman po.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Medyo, simula nung dumating ako dito sa role na ito, nung tinignan namin, medyo matagal na stall, matagal na stall yung privatization initiative. Only now that we are pushing with guidance from the top that we really should prioritize this.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: That we are working now with the station, DBP, and GCG so that finally before the end of the year,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: we can call for an open public bidding for interested parties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So malayo po tayo sa bidding, maaaring mag-fail pa yung bidding, marami pang puwedeng mangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Maaaring mawalan ng interes sa mga kinakausap ninyo. Marami pa kayong kakausapin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So mukhang mahabang panahon po, ang maraming... ilang buwan pang lilipas bago ma-finalize ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So masasabi n’yo po na parang premature at napaaga masyado yung pagtanggal ng pondo sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: habang tayo po ay nagsasabi na lahat po tayo ay talagang nadurog ang puso

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: nang nakita natin ang IBC 13 na nag-zero budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: nandito lang po pala sa in our midst si DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Siya po ay puwede natin tanungin as to the wisdom of the DBM, why it came to be that IBC had zero budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Ma’am, we recognize Assistant Director Lulu.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Good morning, Madam Chair and Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Actually, IBC 13 is really currently under the GOCC, which is listed as under privatization.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: This is pursuant to the memo of the Executive Secretary, dated December 21, 2015.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: So, up to now, yun ang tingin ng DBM because it is an ongoing privatization.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: We have released 424 million for the compensation benefits of the IBC 13 employees.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: So, kung baga, sinusuportahan din naman ng DBM if ever na need talaga na like that.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And ang assumption namin is, last na na po yun, nababayaran namin.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: considering na yung mga retirement benefits na nabayaran na rin namin.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And then, when you speak of yung...

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: arbitration award, which is in the amount of 50 million, I think that was awarded only in June this year.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: E tapos na po ang budget preparation that time.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And nag-re-issue na po kami noon ng confirmation letter.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: So, possible po talagang hindi siya maisasama sa 2027.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Madam Chair, is she a resource person also from DBM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: She's a resource person, therefore I can propound questions to her.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Yes, yes, go ahead, Representative Antonino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So, alam niyo yung arbitration award na kailangan mo yan ng 50 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Tapos, sa kabila nun, dinefund niyo

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Actually, sir, we don't receive any...

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: I mean, we don't need any record.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Yeah, we did not receive any record

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And we don't have any copy of that arbitration award.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: But the DBM was present in the last year's budget deliberations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: And that was one of the issues lengthily discussed during the budget deliberations of PCO.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: That's why, sir, in 2026, the IBC 13 requested for the compensation benefits.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And we granted it out of the Pension Gratuity Fund.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: But you just said that you found out about the arbitration award came down in June of this year.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: And you said it's too late.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And the budget prep season is from April up to May.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And June is already a final deliberation.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And we have to issue our confirmation letter to the agencies.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: But given that this supervening event...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Don't you think that requires an amendment?

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Sir, it's up to the Congress, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Pero don't you think it's wrong for government not to pay legal obligations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: That government should set an example?

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Sir, like what we did in 2026 when they requested for the compensation benefits of those IBC employees,

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: And that is charged against the Pension and Gratuity Fund, po.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: You heard the sentiments and the views of the congressmen here?

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: And you appreciate where we're coming from?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: So, that Assistant Director, should we, should the IBC or Secretary Dave, like, write another

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Because you said, na-receive niyo po June 2026.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: We did not receive any letter or any approval of that, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DBM Assistant Director Lulu P. Vispo
segments.text: Wala ho kaming copy. Kaya we did not, we didn't know na meron palang gano'n na. Yes, yes po.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Madam Chairman, if I may add, no, I will concur with the report of the Director.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: By June 30 this year, tapos na po yung preparation ng NEP, no, na-discuss na po sa cabinet, na-present na po sa Pangulo yun.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: So, medyo, hindi nga siguro umabot, no.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: But tama din po si Congressman na

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: This is a legal obligation that IBC 13 needs to settle.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: So, isasama na lang po namin doon sa summary namin of the budget

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: proposed by the attached agencies that were cut or were not included, but we respectfully

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: ask the committee to restore or to fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you very much, Secretary Dave.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: So, it will all be included in the new quotation. Isasubmit niyo po sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: So, Chair, calls for another suspension.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Chair, since I guess wala namang ibang magtatanong, with that I move to terminate the budget briefing of Presidential Communications Office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Budget hearing of Presidential, the fiscal year budget 2027 of Presidential Commission's Office, including its attached agencies and corporation, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: It has been moved and duly seconded to terminate the hearing on the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the PCO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honors, and our colleagues from the Presidential Communications Office for your valuable participation in today's budget hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Congratulations to the whole PCO family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Madam Chair, with that I would like to move for the suspension of the budget.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Ma'am, ito, ma'am, ito, basahin mo lang 'yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I move to suspend the committee hearing here at Andaya Hall on House Bill No. 10858 until Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 9 a.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Has been moved and duly seconded.
